title: single-writer lease blocks writes outside the shared tree and outlives a finished session
detail: A session that had ended (last turn 15:15, no live process in the repo) still held .sprint/main-writer.json, so the next session's Bash write to its own scratchpad, which is outside the main tree, was denied. Two gaps: the lease guards a target it does not own, and it does not detect that the holder has ended, so the operator must check by hand before release-writer.
